system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: shc_track_sample_status and shc_request_soil_test. Here are my details: my sample_id is SHC-SMP-50000003.

function.name: shc_request_soil_test
function.description: Submits a request for laboratory testing of a collected soil sample. Sample must be in 'collected' or 'in_transit' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate the report or provide nutrient analysis. Fails if sample is still in 'registered' status (not yet collected), or if a test request already exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

function.name: shc_track_sample_status
function.description: Tracks the lifecycle status of a soil sample. Returns sample_status ('registered', 'collected', 'in_transit', 'under_testing', 'tested') with timestamps. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify sample status or generate reports. Fails if sample_id is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.
